index_title: Employment Cost Index: total compensation, private industry workers, transportation and warehousing (not seasonally adjusted)
rationale: Industry-wide labour-cost index (all transportation and warehousing occupations); not pilot-specific. Pilot pay rose faster than this index after 2023 contract settlements, so the adjusted value is a proxy. Series-ID layout per https://www.bls.gov/help/hlpforma.htm; code meanings (U=not seasonally adjusted, 2=private industry, 01=total compensation, 4300=transportation and warehousing, I=index) and title from FRED's mirror of BLS data (BLS catalog pages not retrievable by script). Values retrieved from the official BLS API.

index_title: Producer Price Index by industry: direct property and casualty insurers (not seasonally adjusted)
rationale: All property and casualty lines; not aviation-hull or aviation-liability specific. Proxy only. Values retrieved from the official BLS API.

No verified aircraft-maintenance price index is available: the BLS API reported series PCU488190488190 (Other support activities for air transportation, which includes aircraft maintenance) as non-existent on 2026-10-15, and no other aircraft-maintenance index was verified. A single CPI is not used. Adjustment unavailable.
